scope_note: Eurostat SBS enterprise-denominator crosswalk for the radar verticals. Composite mappings use non-overlapping NACE components within the same vertical. Values from different radar verticals must never be added together because their NACE scopes can overlap.

verticals.statistical_scope: Manufacture of air and spacecraft and related machinery
verticals.limitation: Does not include airlines, airports, space research or the wider aerospace supply chain.

verticals.statistical_scope: Manufacture of motor vehicles, trailers and semi-trailers
verticals.limitation: Does not include vehicle retail, repair, mobility services or all upstream suppliers.
A narrow industrial proxy; it excludes armed forces, most defense services, aerospace defense and dual-use suppliers.

verticals.statistical_scope: Electricity, gas, steam and air-conditioning supply
verticals.limitation: Does not include all extraction, fuel retail or energy-equipment manufacturing.
A broad financial-sector denominator; country coverage may vary in Structural Business Statistics.
Excludes residential care, social work, pharmaceuticals and some public-sector units outside the business population.

verticals.statistical_scope: Manufacture of basic pharmaceutical products and pharmaceutical preparations
verticals.limitation: Does not include the complete biotechnology, medical-device, research or healthcare ecosystem.
Includes Automotive, Aerospace, pharmaceutical and defense-manufacturing subsectors; never add those vertical totals to Manufacturing.
Excludes parts of live entertainment, arts, sports and platform activity classified elsewhere.
Does not cover agriculture, forestry, fishing or the full natural-resources value chain.

verticals.statistical_scope: Public administration and defence; compulsory social security, with NACE O employment and COFOG expenditure as context
verticals.limitation: NACE O is outside SBS. The calculation uses deduplicated opportunity-linked TED buyers as an observed procurement-active lower bound, not the total public-authority population.

verticals.statistical_scope: Retail trade, except motor vehicles and motorcycles
verticals.limitation: Excludes motor retail and some platform activity classified outside retail.
A combined denominator reflecting the radar's combined vertical; the two component sectors should also be available as drill-downs.

verticals.statistical_scope: Wholesale trade, except motor vehicles and motorcycles
verticals.limitation: Excludes motor-vehicle wholesale and retail activity.
